title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Additional Premium Offer
text: An Additional Premium of 0.25% (over and above the existing premium of 0.50%) shall be given to Senior Citizens who wish to book the Fixed Deposit less than 5 crores for a tenure of 5 (five) years One Day to 10 Years, during special deposit offer commencing from 18th May'20 to 1st May 2024.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Applicability to New and Renewal Deposits
text: This special offer will be applicable to new Fixed Deposit booked as well as for the Renewals, by Senior Citizens during the above period. This offer is not applicable to Non-Resident Indian.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Premature Closure Before 5 Years
text: In case of premature closure of Fixed Deposit booked in the above offer (including sweep in / partial closure) on or before 5 years, the interest rate will be 1.00% below the contracted rate or the base rate applicable for the period the deposit has remained with the bank, whichever is lower.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Premature Closure After 5 Years
text: In case of premature closure of Fixed Deposit booked in the above offer (including sweep in / partial closure) post 5 years, the interest rate will be 1.25% below the contracted rate or the base rate applicable for the period the deposit has remained with the bank, whichever is lower.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Rate Inclusive of Premium
text: Rates mentioned on the interest rate page on website are inclusive of 0.75%.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - General FD Terms Applicability
text: All other terms and conditions as applicable to Fixed Deposit shall remain unchanged and the same shall be applicable to the above fixed deposit too.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Eligible Senior Citizens
text: Senior Citizens (60 years and above) who are Resident Indians are eligible for senior citizen rates for deposits less than 5cr.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Non-Applicability to Staff/NRE/NRO Deposits
text: Benefit of additional interest rate on deposits on account of being bank's own staff or senior citizens shall not be applicable to NRE and NRO Deposits.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Quote Deposit Account Number
text: Please quote the Deposit Account Number in all Communication.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Maturity Instruction Recording
text: Please record change of maturity instructions with us well in advance to enable us serve you better.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Online Change of Maturity Instructions
text: Any changes made online in respect to change in maturity instruction / tenure, details can be viewed online post the changes.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Renewal Advice
text: Please ignore this advice If you have redeemed or renewed this deposit on or after the maturity date as mentioned herein. In case of Renewals you will receive a new Fixed Deposit Confirmation / renewal advice.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Monthly Interest Option Rate
text: Rate applicable on monthly interest option will be discounted rate over the standard FD Rate.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Sweep-In Order (LIFO Basis)
text: In case of more than one deposit linked for Sweep-In, the system will first Sweep-In funds from the last or recently opened deposit i.e. on LIFO(Last-In-First-Out) basis.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Nomination Update Requirement
text: In case your fixed deposit is booked without nomination details, please visit the Branch to update the same.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - NRO Premature Withdrawal Interest
text: In case of NRO / Resident FD, no interest will be paid if the deposit is prematurely withdrawn before completion of 7 days.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - NRE Premature Withdrawal Interest
text: In case of NRE FD interest will not be paid if the deposit is prematurely withdrawn before completion of 1 year.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Form 15G/H Non-Applicability
text: Form 15G/H is not applicable to NRIs.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - TDS Non-Applicability on NRE Deposits
text: TDS is not applicable for Interest earned on NRE deposits.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - TDS with Monthly/Quarterly Payout
text: Fixed Deposits booked with monthly or quarterly interest payout option, TDS recovery will by default happen from linked current / savings account. Please visit nearest branch / contact RM for further clarification.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Quarterly Interest Calculation
text: When you open a Fixed deposit with the Bank Interest on Term Deposit is calculated on a Quarterly basis for deposits > 6 months.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Simple Interest for Short-Term Deposits
text: Simple interest is paid at maturity for deposits <= 6 months.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Cumulative Interest Calculation
text: Cumulative Interest/ re-investment interest is calculated every quarter, and is added to the principal such that Interest is paid on the Interest earned in the previous quarter as well.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Monthly Deposit Scheme Interest
text: In case of monthly deposit scheme, the interest shall be calculated for the quarter and paid monthly at discounted rate over the Standard FD Rate.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - FD Rebook Rights
text: If FD is not booked / renewed as per applicable T &C, Bank reserves the right to rebook the same with correct details.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Assistance and Clarification Contact
text: Please visit our website / nearest branch / contact Relationship Manager for further clarification.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Non-Filer TDS Deduction
text: In case of Non-filer of income Tax return, TDS shall also be deducted at higher rate as provided by the Section 206AB, w.e.f 1-Jul-2021.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Income-Tax Provisions Update
text: Income-tax provisions outlined in this document are updated as of the Finance Act, 2021.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Third Party FD Lien
text: In case of third party fixed deposit, lien is marked only on principal amount of the deposit.

title: Senior Citizen Care FD - Rounding Off Rules
text: For Resident & Non-Residents rupee deposits- Rounding off is done basis RBI guideline, RBI/2011-12/56 DBOD No. Leg.BC.18/09.07.006/2011-12. All transactions, including payment of interest on deposits/charging of interest on advances, will be rounded off to the nearest rupee i.e., fractions of 50 paise and above shall be rounded off to the next higher rupee and fraction of less than 50 paise shall be ignored and in case of Foreign currency deposits i.e. FCNR Deposits the rounding off will be done up to two decimal places.
